root_causes: The complete controller certificate for an implicit local multi-hop binding was overwritten by the older exact-anchor helper, so branch assignment preferred a high-support relation that did not answer the subgoal.
Verifier fidelity priced only completion caps. A six-candidate two-sample VERIFY was predicted as 1800 tokens but consumed 4662 prompt-plus-completion tokens and ended before graph mutation.

architectural_delta.projection_authority: For controller-certificate graphs, full_subgoal_coverage is the sole direct-claim projection certificate used by proof recovery and branch commitment; weaker legacy extraction booleans cannot overwrite it.
architectural_delta.prompt_inclusive_cost: Verifier resource packets include a deterministic upper bound for evidence context, tuple schema, candidate count, and completion tokens for every requested sample.
architectural_delta.feasibility: Any exact-accounting packet whose prompt-plus-completion upper bound exceeds remaining tokens is removed before selection; high fidelity also preserves the existing critical-obligation reserve.

execution_order: development canary 5 if causal gate passes
paired control/HARA Shadow-C20 without between-arm inspection if Smoke-A passes
stop_condition: Continue generic no-training diagnosis and iteration after any development failure. Stop only on the full preregistered HARA gate plus committed safe-stop report, or before the next call would exceed the shared 2000-attempt/2000000-token hard cap.
